summary: Resolves the 'config' entry of an input structure/collection (a1) via sub_587C20, formats the found value as "config=%s" into an 80-byte stack buffer through the length-checked StrlenFormatCallWrapper, and, when the format succeeds, returns the string copied to a persistent/reallocated buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Fails fast with the source result if a1 is null, the key is absent, or formatting fails.

local_names.a1: input structure or collection that owns the config entry
local_names.aConfig: key string used for the config lookup
local_names.v2: 80-byte stack buffer receiving the formatted string
local_names.result: propagated return value from the last executed stage

operations.description: result = a1: the default (fall-through) return value is the input pointer itself
If a1 is zero the function returns a1 immediately; all lookups are blocked
sub_587C20(a1, aConfig) looks up the 'config' key value inside the a1 structure/collection; the key string is the global aConfig at 0x005C303C
If the lookup result is zero (config key not found) the function returns 0
StrlenFormatCallWrapper(result, "config=%s", v2) length-checked-formatting of the found value into the 80-byte stack buffer v2
If the format result is not exactly 1 the function returns the format result code; the copy step is blocked
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v2) copies the formatted string to a persistent/reallocated buffer and returns that buffer
Returns the copied buffer on success, otherwise the format result code, the lookup result, or the original a1; the caller is GameMainEntry (0x0045B200)
